text: With testing done, Devon rolls Warranty Claims out to all roughly 150 Cascade Ridge Outfitters users across Sales and Service.
Training runs as three focused sessions -- West reps, East reps, and a combined session for both regional managers and Sales Ops.
Marisol Fontaine sends the official rollout announcement herself, so the change lands as a business priority, not an IT project.
Go-live day goes smoothly: claims flow in from both regions, queues fill correctly, and nobody gets stuck.
Next: a few weeks later, two regional managers notice something doesn't add up.
